It sounds really hard to feel constantly worried and upset, especially when you're not getting the support you need from your mom. What you're describing — persistent worry and feeling overwhelmed by small things — is something many people struggle with, and your feelings are valid. It's not your fault, and you deserve to feel better.

Even if your mom isn't helping right now, there are other options. You can talk to a school counselor, teacher, or another trusted adult who can help you figure out next steps. You can also reach out to a youth helpline or text line (like texting HOME to 741741 in the U.S.) to talk with someone who can listen and help you find resources. If you ever feel like you're in crisis or unsafe, please contact emergency services or a crisis line right away. You don't have to handle this alone.
